note: Colombia's own record industry was young (Discos Fuentes 1934, Sonolux 1949); many local hits were recorded abroad or only later re-recorded, so recording years here are approximate (Lucho Bermúdez's 1943 hits per Spanish Wikipedia; Buitrago's Discos Fuentes sides 1947-49). Radio was dominated by Argentine tango, Mexican film song and Cuban music.
